push.title: W 3-0 vs Paris Saint Bal | You: 7.0 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.0 is a quiet night for a midfielder. Quiet nights teach the loudest lessons.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Paris Saint Bal. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ Man of the Match. Man of the Match: the highest compliment the game gives out.
+ That 7.0 sits as your 2nd best match performance of the season. Lovely stuff.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (2 vs their best 1). That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of Paris Saint Bal. Put that in the team scrapbook.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Quick fix: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. Believe.
- 67% passing (2 of 3). Quick one: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- Rating came in 0.6 below what your on-ball stats earned. Bread and butter: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
- Same defensive work rate trouble for you and BellyTb1. Buddy up: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Key passes: 0. You're in the conversation. 2+ wins the argument.

Muscle memory: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Between you and me, buddskees: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

Shake it off and lace up. - Coach Lasso

- A 6.9, your 5th worst match performance of the season. Short memory, long season.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

Stay hungry, stay humble. - Coach Lasso
